brief.situation: You are the SRE on call at Larkin Grocers. Support reports a rising number of failed card payments since about 14:00, but Logs Explorer shows nothing from the checkout service since yesterday, and Error Reporting is empty. Yesterday a cost review added an exclusion to the _Default sink for checkout's noisy logs. The weekend promotion starts at 16:30 and the payment team needs the errors to find the cause.
handover: The cost review's goal was to stop paying for checkout's DEBUG and INFO volume (90% of its logs).
Checkout logs structured JSON with a severity field.
howItWorks: The terminal shows each command's output; the diagram shows checkout's logs, the _Default sink and its exclusion filter, and the tools that read the stored logs.
Each command takes a minute or two; the clock moves only when you act or wait.
When you close, you write the record and explain your reasoning.

writeup.question: For the record: why checkout's errors were invisible, what you changed, and how cost and visibility are balanced now.

parts.label: Why
parts.modelAnswer: Yesterday's exclusion on the _Default sink matched every checkout entry, with no severity clause, so errors were dropped before storage; the pods were still writing them.

parts.label: Changed
parts.modelAnswer: Added severity<=INFO to the exclusion: warnings and errors are stored again, and the saving keeps 91% of its effect. Disabling the sink would have dropped every log in the project; earlier errors were never stored and are gone.

parts.label: Balance
parts.modelAnswer: An alert fires if checkout ingests no errors while serving traffic, and cost exclusions on application logs must keep WARNING and above.

allDark.headline: Fix the filter, not the router
allDark.body: The exclusion was too broad. Narrow its filter to the severities it was meant to drop; the sink that stores everything else must stay on.

promoBlind.headline: Excluded logs never arrive
promoBlind.body: Exclusion filters drop entries before storage; Logs Explorer and Error Reporting cannot show them. Narrow the filter so errors are kept.

scoring.modelReasoning: Checkout is writing errors, but the exclusion on the _Default sink matches every checkout entry, so they are dropped before storage and no tool can show them. Narrow the exclusion to DEBUG and INFO, which still saves most of the volume, and check that errors arrive. Disabling the sink drops all logs; a wider search finds nothing because excluded entries are never stored. Then alert on silence and require a severity clause in cost exclusions.
